title: publish bounded payload metadata index to hosted mirror without large artifact storage

criteria: Remote manifest, checksums, and signature-required metadata are published under /payloads/aios/production-distro-rc6-current-artifacts/.
Remote /install/bootstrap.json and /channel/index.json are hash-bound to the hosted payload metadata.
Large payload storage remains disabled and no signing, install, activation, rollback, support upload, remote dispatch, production ring, or TUI authority is granted.
Remote validation uses curl --resolve and blocks directory listing and write methods.
